bio.text: Alex Lee is a Democratic member of the California State Assembly representing District 24; his current term ends on December 7, 2026.
He was born in California and earned an undergraduate degree from the University of California, Davis, in 2017.
His career experience includes working as a legislative policy advisor for the California State Senate and Assembly.
He advanced from the June 2, 2026 primary and is on the November 3, 2026 general election ballot.
